clue.text: Hasty writing that is crude ending for novel

parts.note: SC is the abbreviation of scilicet, Latin for 'that is to say'
crude means raw, unrefined

indicators.note: ending for asks for the final letter of the word novel

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a manuscript's rough finish as hurried, unpolished prose.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrawl is untidy handwriting dashed off in a hurry, a synonym for hasty writing.

clue.text: In face, punch a mate

parts.note: to chin someone is slang for punching them on the jaw, a punch in the face

explanation.surface: A violent instruction to hit a friend in the face.
explanation.walkthrough: CHINA is cockney rhyming slang: china plate = mate.
explanation.definitionFit: Cockney rhyming slang 'china plate' rhymes with mate, so a china is a pal.

clue.text: Predatory cold-blooded killer distressed a girl a lot

indicators.note: distressed signals that the letters of 'a girl a lot' are knocked out of shape and rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl is much alarmed by a reptilian predator.
explanation.definitionFit: An alligator is a large carnivorous reptile, a cold-blooded hunter of prey.

clue.text: Delayed, on the way now

indicators.note: in a down clue, on places the first piece above the second

parts.note: delayed means late
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A traveller reports being held up while still en route.
explanation.definitionFit: The latest thing is the most current or up to date, what is fashionable now.

clue.text: After trip request refreshing drink

definitions.meaning: after stumbling, a fallen person might ask someone to help them back to their feet
a tonic or stimulating drink that revives you

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both the plea of someone who has fallen and a reviving tonic drink.

clue.text: Somebody getting shot in the news

definitions.text: Somebody getting shot in the news

parts.words: Somebody getting shot in the news
parts.note: reads as a shooting victim reported in the papers, but means someone taking photographs for the press

explanation.surface: A news report about a person who has been shot.
explanation.definitionFit: A press photographer takes shots (pictures) for newspapers, a reporter working with a camera.

clue.text: Stern person shouting at those having a row

definitions.text: Stern person shouting at those having a row

parts.words: Stern person shouting at those having a row
parts.note: seems a strict person yelling at quarrellers, but describes the steerer at the back of a rowing boat calling to the crew

explanation.surface: A severe figure berates people who are arguing.
explanation.walkthrough: Stern is the back of a boat, and a row is rowing, not a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: The cox sits in the boat's stern and calls instructions to the rowing crew.

clue.text: Mother finds son out of control

indicators.note: out of signals that the letter for son is removed from the word for control

parts.note: to master something is to control it
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A mother discovers her son is behaving wildly.
explanation.definitionFit: Mater is Latin for mother, used in old-fashioned British slang for one's mum.

clue.text: Name a hundred manoeuvres that might be deceptive

indicators.note: manoeuvres signals that the letters are moved about into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Moving a hundred soldiers about could be a cunning ruse.
explanation.definitionFit: Underhand dealings are sly and secret, so deceptive in character.

clue.text: Love letter written in language of Romance

definitions.text: Love letter written in language of Romance

parts.words: Love letter written in language of Romance
parts.note: a romantic note, with the 'language of Romance' being French, a Romance language

explanation.surface: A romantic letter penned in the language of love.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase literally means 'sweet note', the term used for a love letter.

clue.text: Fuss made over daughter as well

indicators.note: made over suggests the word for as well is covering, wrapped around, the daughter

parts.note: as well means too

explanation.surface: A parent's fuss over their daughter is also noted.
explanation.definitionFit: A to-do is a commotion or bother, a synonym for fuss.

clue.text: Seaweed finally making fool break oars at sea

indicators.note: break means the second piece splits the anagram open
at sea means confused, so the letters of oars are jumbled
finally asks for the last letter of making

parts.note: an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: An idiot in a rowing boat snaps the oars on weed at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' jumbles the oars and 'break' opens them; the surface's sea fits, since this weed names the Sargasso Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Sargasso is a floating brown seaweed that gives the Sargasso Sea its name.

clue.text: Suspicious about extremely clever slogan

indicators.note: about signals the word for suspicious goes round the other piece

parts.note: wary means suspicious, cautious

indicators.note: extremely takes the first and last letters of clever

explanation.surface: Someone doubts a very smart advertising line.
explanation.definitionFit: A war cry is a rallying call, and by extension a slogan for a campaign.

clue.text: After blow, Mark was left in the rain

indicators.note: in signals the letter for left goes inside the word for the rain

parts.note: the wet is rainy weather

explanation.surface: After a punch, Mark was abandoned outside in a downpour.
explanation.definitionFit: A welt is a raised mark on the skin left after a blow.

clue.text: Net profit, one hopes, from such business

definitions.text: Net profit, one hopes, from such business

parts.words: Net profit, one hopes, from such business
parts.note: net profit seems financial, but the Net here is the internet, from which online trade hopes to profit

explanation.surface: A firm hopes its trade will produce a profit after costs.
explanation.definitionFit: E-commerce is buying and selling over the internet, a business done on the Net.

clue.text: Novel said to be about soldier returning home

indicators.note: to be about means the word for said surrounds the next pieces

parts.note: oral means spoken, said

indicators.note: returning means the word for soldier is read backwards

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
in means at home

explanation.surface: A soldier is reported to be on his way back home in a story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns the soldier round, and 'to be about' wraps the word for said round him and home; 'Novel' poses as a noun but is an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Original and novel both mean new and never seen before.

clue.text: Popular classes someone learning attends usually

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable
genera are biological classes or kinds
L is a learner, as on L-plates

explanation.surface: A well-liked student regularly goes to lessons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'attends' is a link meaning L follows the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means as a rule or in most cases, synonymous with usually.

clue.text: In island picked up woman worthy of love

indicators.note: In signals the woman's name goes inside the reversed island
in a down clue, picked up means reading upwards, so the island is reversed

parts.note: Elba is the Mediterranean island of Napoleon's exile
Dora is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A lovable woman is collected on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' reads Napoleon's island upwards, as suits a down clue, and 'In' puts the woman inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Adorable describes someone so charming they inspire affection and love.

clue.text: I like going for spin in car when it's hot

definitions.text: I like going for spin in car when it's hot

parts.words: I like going for spin in car when it's hot
parts.note: reads as enjoying a drive in warm weather, but hot means stolen, so this is a thief speeding in a stolen car

explanation.surface: A driver enjoys summer outings in the car.
explanation.definitionFit: A joyrider steals a car and drives it recklessly for fun.

clue.text: Writer from the east English like a lot

indicators.note: in an across clue, from the east means reading right to left

parts.note: to dig something is slang for liking it a lot

explanation.surface: An eastern author is much admired by the English.
explanation.walkthrough: E + DIG read right to left gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: André Gide was a French novelist and Nobel laureate in literature.

clue.text: Small boys swindled one

parts.note: Vic is a short form of a boy's name such as Victor
Tim is a short form of Timothy

explanation.surface: Some little boys cheated somebody.
explanation.definitionFit: A victim is a person who is cheated or harmed, someone swindled.

clue.text: One married couple weaken

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a pair is a couple

explanation.surface: A single married couple grows weaker.
explanation.definitionFit: To impair is to damage or diminish, synonymous with weaken.

clue.text: Noon? Correct!

definitions.meaning: midday is the close of the morning, the a.m. end
to correct a text is to revise it

explanation.definitionFit: To amend is to put right, and split up the word describes the finish of the morning.

clue.text: Shrink in US court from a legal right? It's wrong

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid

indicators.note: wrong signals the letters of it's are put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: A lawyer disputes whether some legal claim is valid.
explanation.definitionFit: Alienist is an old term, still used in American courts, for a psychiatrist, slangily a shrink.

clue.text: Speaking, appear healthy

definitions.meaning: to give an impression by speech, as in seeming happy on the phone
in good condition, as in 'safe and well'

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to seem when heard, and also fit and in good condition.

clue.text: Begrudge a little backing in press

indicators.note: backing means the run is read backwards
a little means only a short run of letters from begrudge is used

explanation.surface: Someone resents the small support offered in the papers.
explanation.walkthrough: Begrudge read backwards is EGDURGEB, holding the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To press someone is to urge them, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Wayward oboist sure to get rollicking

indicators.note: wayward means going astray, so the letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: An unruly oboe player is sure to get a telling-off.
explanation.walkthrough: Rollicking looks like a noun (a British telling-off) but is the adjective definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Rollicking and boisterous both describe noisy, exuberant high spirits.

clue.text: Whacked a lazy so-and-so

definitions.meaning: an idle layabout who avoids work

explanation.definitionFit: Dead beat means worn out, and a deadbeat is a shiftless idler.

clue.text: Refrain from rejecting state aid, in my case

indicators.note: in signals the reversed aid goes inside the word my

parts.note: my provides the case, the outer letters

indicators.note: rejecting means the word for state aid is turned back

parts.note: the dole is state unemployment benefit

explanation.surface: Someone personally declines welfare payments.
explanation.definitionFit: A refrain is a recurring tune in a song, so a melody.
